description: Golden for issue 6.6 guarded session delete. SYNTHETIC: the MyChron6 held 0 on-board sessions at 6.2 capture time, so no real delete traffic was observed. The delete opcode and ack/reject response shape are HYPOTHESIZED; these values freeze build_delete_request byte-for-byte (delete/request.bin) and the ack/reject contract (delete/ack.bin, delete/reject.bin) so a real capture can be diffed against them. See docs/device/PROTOCOL.md §7. Real-capture tracking: issue #130.
